implementation.growth: Acknowledged video bitrate increases by at most10% per healthy step, with a minimum1-kbit integer quantum. Cadence increases at most1fps. Above10fps the bitrate factor is also bounded by the cadence ratio. Profile ceilings retained.
implementation.timing: At most one successful positive operation per observation and950ms on timestamped runtime callers; preview/refused native operations spend no credit. Clock rollback resets the local interval and grants no step; idle gaps grant no accumulated credit.
implementation.protection: Reductions remain immediate. A separately admitted1-fps recovery probe is funded immediately; it is not ramped from the protective1-kbit/0.02fps state. Interrupted pending ramps require fresh healthy recovery.
implementation.native_consistency: Partial or refused initial budgets cannot bank nominal rungs. Recreated streams restore the last actual budget, clamped to the route ceiling. 1:1/group hosts and both fixture bridges use the same timestamped policy.
implementation.diagnostics: Reports expose last acknowledged bitrate/FPS. Group retune logs use actual budget.
